_help: Weapon perks. 'effect' selects the code path in scripts/gear/perk_system.gd; the other fields are its parameters. 'glyph' + 'icon_color' draw the perk badge in the UI. 'playstyle': true marks perks that change how you play (detonating hits, kill-reload rhythm, grenade loop, kill sustain, crouch/slide fighting) as opposed to plain on-kill stat buffs (false); the Merchant guarantees at least one playstyle perk on Legendary / Mythic offers (data/merchant.json playstyle_perks_min). 'signature': true = a Mythic-only signature perk: never in random rolls (GearDB.roll_weapon skips it, MAIN_HOOKS §19c); the Merchant gives each Mythic offer one (data/merchant.json mythic_signature_perks). Signatures reuse stateless effect paths, so they stack safely with pool perks. 'tag' groups attributes by how they play (mag_rhythm, reload_rhythm, kill_streak, movement, stance, status, detonation, sustain, grenade_loop) for the UI and Merchant. attribute_counts (playtest #33): Common 0, Uncommon 1, Rare 2, Legendary 3 (>= 1 playstyle), Mythic 3 + its signature; rolls use the weapon's attr_seed (GearDB.roll_attributes) so a host-rolled gun is the same everywhere.

attribute_counts._help: Named attributes (= perks) rolled per rarity, playtest #33 (Skillz, WEAPON_ATTRS.md). A Mythic also carries its archetype's signature perk (weapons.json mythic.perk) on top. playstyle_min: rolled attributes that must be playstyle (Legendary / Mythic 1).
